notes.title: New Game! and info about next update.
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

Escape From The Dragons will be updated with new content in January that will enhance the gameplay experience. We are looking to add as much things as we can, possibly a new level and of course, bug fixes.

But while work on the game, why don't you check out our other new game, Space Struck Run.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33820850/a14086709e92986a6895f1582c8c813043b92838.jpg

Just like The Sky Climber and Escape From The Dragons, it is a small game where you have to survive as long as you can, but this time... in space! 

Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/994650/Space_Struck_Run/

It released just a few days ago, so we are still fixing a couple bugs and adding a leaderboard. Either way, we hope that you all are able to enjoy it.
The linux and mac versions will be available in the next few days.

Oh yeah... Merry Christmas!

Thanks!
